    The bar cochain complex #

    The normalized relative bar complexes of Section 6 (positive-deformations.tex, module bar complex) and Section 7 (Hochschild complex) are both cochains f(a_1, …, a_n) with values in a bimodule X and differential `df(a_1, …, a_{n+1}) = a_1 f(a_2, …) + Σ (-1)^i f(…, a_i a_{i+1}, …)

    • (-1)^{n+1} f(a_1, …, a_n) a_{n+1}. For a right module bar complex Hom(M ⊗ Λ̄^{⊗n}, N)takeX = Hom_k(M, N)with `(a·φ)(m) = φ(ma), (φ·b)(m) = φ(m)b`.

    Cochains are encoded as functions of sequences ℕ → Λ (only the first n entries matter for the cochains used later); the coface maps then satisfy the cosimplicial identities as identities of sequence operations (coface_comm), and d ∘ d = 0 (d_d) follows by the usual pairing of terms.

    structure MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.Bar.Act (Λ : Type u_1) [Ring Λ] (X : Type u_2) [AddCommGroup X] :
    Type (max u_1 u_2)

    Bimodule actions on X: l a x = a·x, r b x = x·b.

    • l : Λ → X →+ X
    • r : Λ → X →+ X
    • l_mul (a b : Λ) (x : X) : (self.l (a * b)) x = (self.l a) ((self.l b) x)
    • r_mul (a b : Λ) (x : X) : (self.r b) ((self.r a) x) = (self.r (a * b)) x
    • lr (a b : Λ) (x : X) : (self.l a) ((self.r b) x) = (self.r b) ((self.l a) x)
